title: A merge from main after a fix check can still get a review record
why: merge --review-record refuses --fix-check when the newest earlier record already has a Fix check line, so a lane that merges main after its fix pass (PR #1186, head e304a0033) cannot record the merge's fix check.
note: Filed by triage 13:00 CST Nov 10. Refusal text: 'the reviewed head must be the Head of the newest earlier review record on this pull request, and that record must have no Fix check line' (decision pr-review-record). Done when a merge-from-main fix check records against the prior record's head, with a test red on main. Coordinator 13:03 CST: build it with triage's agents; #1186 waits on it, and #2508 waits on #1186. Done when #1186's merge from main gets a record that `merge --reviewed` reads as done.
